decisive_items: Multiple small capillary malformations on trunk (hyperpigmented)
Erythema on forehead and right eyelid
Abnormal enhancement of right inferior turbinate mucosa
response.rationale: Sturge-Weber syndrome is more likely due to the combination of capillary malformations, erythema, and abnormal enhancement on CT, which are characteristic features of this syndrome

rejected.why: Lack of specific features unique to PHACE syndrome
